entries.subject: USGS Cassini–Voyager 2010 global mosaic
entries.finding: Selected 154 m map supplies Monochrome; exact zero is gap while other dark values remain observed, and its 563 km map sphere remains distinct from other source frames.

entries.subject: NASA/JPL PIA18434 enhanced-color map
entries.finding: Selected ultraviolet/infrared product supplies Enhanced color after producer calibration, registration and photometric correction; it is not natural color and has no separate validity mask.

entries.subject: Dione 2025 SPC Q128 OBJ
entries.finding: Selected Q128 OBJ supplies geometry and Shape; 2,000-face rendering approximation remains distinct from source uncertainty and cartographic registration.

entries.subject: Dione 2025 SPC equatorial and polar radius grids
entries.finding: Selected equatorial and polar grids supply Elevation as radius minus the 561.4 km source sphere. Join gaps remain marked and the numeric datum is separate from display scale.

entries.subject: Dione 2025 SPC relative-albedo grids
entries.finding: Selected dimensionless equatorial and polar fields supply Relative albedo. They are normalized around one, less validated than topography, not geometric albedo or calibrated reflectance, and visually clip above 1.5.

entries.subject: Scipioni et al. Cassini VIMS infrared mosaic
entries.finding: Selected registered PDS product supplies Infrared with its own source wavelengths, phase-function parameters and coverage limits.

entries.subject: Scipioni et al. Cassini VIMS ice-absorption product
entries.finding: Selected PDS product supplies Ice absorption as a spectral signal, not abundance, under the same documented source limits.

entries.subject: Photographic and scientific map registration to the shape
entries.finding: The README says geographic registration, silhouette and feature review remain pending; current display checks do not qualify map-to-shape registration.
entries.revisitWhen: A source-to-shape registration review with independent feature and silhouette evidence is completed.
